title: Scope console UI state and notification channels per tenant
description: In multi-tenant mode AppState has one ui_state and one notification_tx, and get_realtime_events ignores account/project, so focus/search UI state and IssueUpdated notifications leak across tenants (rust/src/bin/console_local.rs). Behavior change: write a console-server Gherkin scenario first (two tenants, a focus notification on one is not delivered to the other), then key ui_state and notification channels by (account, project) in Rust and match in the Python console server. Acceptance: new scenario passes in both runtimes.
